description: Changes a saved diagram as a new revision; old ones stay. Give baseRevision (the revision you last read), a one-line message, and ops (typed operations, https://zindex.ai/schemas/ops.schema.json), mermaid (the whole diagram edited from view mermaid; only differences apply), restoreRevision (an earlier version back), or brief. An edit with an error saves nothing; one that changes nothing returns noop. requestId makes a retry return the first result. A conflict lists what changed.

brief.description: Replace the brief; null removes it

mermaid.description: The whole diagram as Mermaid; not with ops or restoreRevision

message.description: One line on what the edit does and why

requestId.description: Your id for this edit, e.g. a UUID

restoreRevision.description: A revision number, or { asOf } for the version current at that instant

name: diagram_edit
title: Change a diagram
